name: Puffco | Puffco Plus Chamber One | Onyx
description:
The Plus is where it all began. This award-winning portable vaporizer makes it easy to enjoy extract anywhere. The Plus mouthpiece houses the Dart, a 3-in-1 splash guard, carb cap, and loading tool – giving you a seamless and discreet dab on the go experience. Its 510 battery has one button and three precision heat settings, plus Sesh Mode – each delivering optimal flavor and vapor.

See why we called it the Plus?
